errors.evidence: The entire mapping of labels to colors is incorrect. The legend shows: 'no SFT' is pale blue striped; '+ SFT on D₀' is light orange striped; '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' is light purple striped; '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' is solid light red.

errors.text_span: The "no SFT" bars for "LLaMA-2-7B", "LLaMA-2-13B" and "LLaMA-2-70B" have approximate values of 22%, 25% and 27% respectively.

errors.text_span: The bars representing "+ SFT on D₀" generally have values between 65% and 72%.
errors.evidence: The values for the '+ SFT on D₀' bars are approximately 66%, 74%, and 82%. The stated range of 65-72% is incorrect and does not cover the full range of values.

errors.text_span: The pink-purple bars representing "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" tend to have the greatest values in each group
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect for two of the three groups. For 'LLaMA-2-13B' and 'LLaMA-2-70B', the tallest bar is the light purple striped one ('+ SFT on D₀, D₁'), not the solid red one ('+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂').

errors.text_span: reaching a height of approximately 80% for "LLaMA-2-70B"
errors.evidence: For 'LLaMA-2-70B', the bar for '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' reaches a height of approximately 83%, which is visibly higher than the 80% line.

The description fails to mention the different fill patterns used for the bars. Three of the four bar types have distinct stripe patterns (two diagonal, one horizontal), and one is solid. This is a visual distinction beyond just color.
